`caravel` is one CLI for every template. Each command finds `lane.toml` in the current directory (or `-f`) and uses its default deployment (or `--env`). Every command takes `--json`, which prints JSON on stdout for scripts while progress goes to stderr.

These pages are generated from `caravel help`, so they match the binary they were built from.

## Deploy and change a lane

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`caravel plan`](./plan.md) | Show what `apply` would change on Stellar and on the host. Changes nothing |
| [`caravel apply`](./apply.md) | Make Stellar and the host match the deployment. Shows the plan and asks first, unless --yes. Running it again changes nothing. Given a saved plan (`caravel plan --out FILE`), applies exactly that plan |
| [`caravel status`](./status.md) | A deployment's health: height, the last accepted checkpoint, when a freeze would be possible, the relayer's XLM, TTL horizons, and whether it matches the lane file |
| [`caravel destroy`](./destroy.md) | Wind a lane down for good: drain, stop the sequencer and relayer, export every exit with its proof to exit.json, then freeze once the contract allows it. A frozen lane can't be restarted |
| [`caravel graph`](./graph.md) | The deployment's resources and what each depends on, as Graphviz DOT (`caravel graph \| dot -Tsvg > lane.svg`), or as JSON. Dashed edges restart their target when their source changes |

## Check a lane file

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`caravel validate`](./validate.md) | Check the lane file without Stellar or a host: each deployment's rules, the genesis, and the identities it names |
| [`caravel render`](./render.md) | The deployment as `plan` reads it: includes, inheritance, vars and expressions resolved. With --genesis, the genesis document the template hashes and the hosts get as lane.toml |
| [`caravel env`](./env/index.md) | The lane file's deployments |
| [`caravel output`](./output.md) | A deployment's addresses and URLs, from the lane file and its keys; one of them with NAME |
| [`caravel doctor`](./doctor.md) | Check that this machine can run the deployment: the Stellar CLI, Node.js, the template, the release and the identities |
| [`caravel version`](./version.md) | This CLI, the templates it finds and the Stellar CLI it needs |

## Run the nodes

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`caravel start`](./start.md) | Start nodes that aren't running (all when none is named). Refuses if the deployment differs from the lane file in anything else: that's apply's |
| [`caravel stop`](./stop.md) | Stop nodes (all of them when none is named) and leave the lane as it is: no checkpoint is posted while the sequencer is down, and after the contract's escape timeout anyone may freeze the lane |
| [`caravel restart`](./restart.md) | Stop and start nodes (all when none is named) |
| [`caravel logs`](./logs.md) | A node's log: the last lines, then with --follow what it writes |
| [`caravel wait`](./wait/index.md) | Wait until something holds (exit 4 if the time runs out) |
| [`caravel api`](./api.md) | GET a path of the lane's API (or a validator's) and print the JSON |
| [`caravel replay`](./replay.md) | Replay the lane from Stellar alone (spec §16), with the deployment's contract, network and engine; optionally an account's proofs |

## Use a lane

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`caravel account`](./account/index.md) | A user's Stellar account for the lane: an identity on the network with a trustline to the settlement token, and some of it |
| [`caravel balance`](./balance.md) | An account's settlement token on Stellar, and its lane account (a C… contract's on Stellar only) |
| [`caravel deposit`](./deposit.md) | Deposit into the lane; returns once the lane has credited it |
| [`caravel tx`](./tx.md) | Sign a lane transaction with SEP-53 through the Stellar CLI keystore and send it; waits until a block takes it and prints its result |
| [`caravel withdraw`](./withdraw.md) | Withdraw from the lane: the transaction, then its leaf in an accepted checkpoint, then the claim on Stellar |
| [`caravel claim`](./claim.md) | Claim every unclaimed withdrawal of an account on Stellar |
| [`caravel force-withdraw`](./force-withdraw.md) | Ask the settlement contract for a withdrawal the lane must include (when it won't take one), then claim it |
| [`caravel escape`](./escape.md) | After a freeze: claim an account's withdrawals and its share of the lane's last checkpoint |

## Start a lane

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`caravel init`](./init.md) | Start a lane: write DIR/lane.toml from a template's example, and create the Stellar CLI identities it names (`<name>-<role>`) |
| [`caravel keys`](./keys/index.md) | The Stellar CLI identities a deployment names |
